metadata.zh_title: 揭帷 - 全球主權防衛與官方解密情報總帳

agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security

en.title: DoD AARO: Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
en.executive_summary: Mandated congressional annual report summarizing military sensor logs, nuclear installation incursions, and formal procedures for handling potential anomalous materials.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防部 AARO：未知異常現象 (UAP) 法定財政年度綜合報告與核設施入侵審查
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據聯邦法規 50 U.S.C. § 3373 向國會提交之年度法定解密全卷。統整全美軍事與海軍艦隊最新通報、登錄多起核武器與戰略設施周邊異常空情，並首度載明五角大廈針對潛在回收異常實體材料所制定之跨部會官方處理處置規程。

en.title: Federal Aviation Administration: Formal Air Traffic Procedures for Reporting Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
en.executive_summary: Statutory air traffic operating regulations issued by the FAA mandating formal reporting pathways from civil aviation to defense anomaly offices.

zh_hk.title: 美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA)：空中交通管制未知異常現象 (UAP) 官方安全通報條令
zh_hk.executive_summary: 聯邦航空總署修訂之官方作業指引。正式確立民航飛行員與航空管制台 (ATC) 遭遇異常空情之法定通報路徑，要求空管單位即時通報國家戰術安全協調官，並將雷達與通聯數據正式移交國防部 AARO 列管審查。

agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

en.title: DoD AARO: Report on the Historical Record of USG Involvement with UAP (Volume 2 - Contemporary Allegations Review)
en.executive_summary: Statutory Volume 2 historical evaluation compiled by AARO investigating contemporary whistleblower allegations, special access architectures, and material verification.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防部 AARO：美國政府涉 UAP 歷史記錄審查報告 (第二卷 - 當代吹哨指控與專案審計)
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據國防授權法法定審查義務，AARO 針對近期國會宣誓聽證會吹哨人指控、非公開特殊權限專案 (USAP) 傳聞、敏感國防承包商實體物證查驗及跨機構情報訪談所發布之官方審計報告第二卷。

agencies: US Senate Committee on Armed Services
Subcommittee on Emerging Threats and Capabilities

en.title: Senate Armed Services Subcommittee on Emerging Threats: Open Hearing on the DoD All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office
en.executive_summary: Official Senate Armed Services hearing testimony and case analysis reviewing DoD anomaly tracking, sensor telemetry, and installation security.

zh_hk.title: 美國參議院軍事委員會新興威脅小組：國防部全域異常解析辦公室 (AARO) 運作與空域威脅公開審查聽證會
zh_hk.executive_summary: 由參議員 Kirsten Gillibrand 主持，AARO 主任 Jon Kosloski 博士就國防部年度調查進展、基地空域不明目標入侵事件及軍方跨部門去保密化進程，向參議院軍事委員會提供之正式宣誓聽證出版品。

sources.label: Senate Armed Services Committee Hearing Record (US-SENATE-SASC-AARO-HEARING-20241119)

en.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposals, Submissions, and Approvals: All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO)
en.executive_summary: Department of Defense notice regarding public information collection, secure reporting procedures, and data repository integrity under Title 10 provisions.

zh_hk.title: 擬議資訊收集暨公眾諮詢公告：全領域異常解析辦公室 (AARO) 專項業務
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部正式發布之聯邦公報，依據《美國法典》第 10 卷授權，針對設立公眾通報途徑、保障異常現象數據安全存檔與資訊徵詢機制徵集公眾意見。

agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI)

en.title: Office of the Director of National Intelligence: Statutory Annual Assessment on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
en.executive_summary: Mandated statutory assessment prepared annually by the Director of National Intelligence synthesizing military intelligence and aerospace sensor logs across the US Intelligence Community.

zh_hk.title: 美國國家情報總監辦公室 (ODNI)：未知異常現象 (UAP) 全美情報界法定年度解密評估報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據聯邦情報法規常態化條款，統籌全美 18 個情報機構、三軍各戰區司令部及感測器網絡之數據。發布年度官方通報案例數、感測器特徵分類、跨介質目標比例及國家安全威脅評估結論。

agencies: House Committee on Oversight and Accountability
Subcommittee on National Security, the Border, and Foreign Affairs
Subcommittee on Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Government Innovation

en.title: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Exposing the Truth (House Oversight Hearing)
en.executive_summary: Official joint congressional hearing transcript examining Department of Defense over-classification, crash retrieval program allegations, and advanced aerospace incursions.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院監督委員會：未知異常現象 (UAP) 揭示真相聯合宣誓聽證會正式出版紀錄本
zh_hk.executive_summary: 2024 年 11 月 13 日眾議院國家安全與網絡安全小組委員會聯合聽證會。前國防官員與海軍少將宣誓作證確認敏感國防設施遭異常科技監控，並將跨部會機密隱匿體系載入國會正式公報。

en.title: US Congressional Record: Whistleblower Report on DoD Unacknowledged SAP 'Immaculate Constellation'
en.executive_summary: Whistleblower dossier officially entered into the US Congressional Record detailing an alleged unacknowledged special access program managing military anomaly sensor captures.

zh_hk.title: 美國國會公報：國防部未公開特殊權限專案『無瑕星座 (Immaculate Constellation)』吹哨者存證報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 由現任及前任國防官員吹哨並經眾議院監督委員會主席正式准予載入國會紀錄之 12 頁官方報告。揭露五角大廈自 2017 年起設立專門隔離專案，對全軍截獲之高解析度異常光學與多光譜遙測數據實施集中封存與審查迴避。

en.title: NASA Science Mission Directorate: Open Science Framework and Observational Database for UAP
en.executive_summary: Open-access scientific anomaly datasets and multi-sensor space-based observational telemetry compiled under NASA's UAP research directive.

zh_hk.title: 美國國家航空暨太空總署 (NASA)：未知異常現象開放科學研究架構與衛星觀測資料庫
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據 NASA 獨立科學專家小組建議設立之常設研究專案。調動地球觀測衛星群、多光譜感測器及人工智慧異常偵測演算法，建置完全透明公開之民用科學 UAP 觀測數據庫與同儕審查研究標準。

en.title: US Senate: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Disclosure Act (Schumer-Rounds Amendment)
en.executive_summary: Landmark Senate legislative mandate proposing the creation of a presidential Records Review Board and defining Non-Human Intelligence (NHI) within federal law.

zh_hk.title: 美國參議院：未知異常現象披露法案 (UAPDA / 舒默-朗茲跨黨派法案)
zh_hk.executive_summary: 由參議院多數黨領袖 Chuck Schumer 與參議員 Mike Rounds 跨黨派提出之重大立法。歷史首次於聯邦法律文本中正式定義『非人類智慧 (NHI)』、『未知來源技術』與『歷史遺留專案』，並設立直屬總統之獨立審查委員會及私營承包商物證國家徵收權條款。

agencies: National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences (NAOC)

en.title: National Astronomical Observatories, CAS: Official FAST SETI Observation & Technosignature Survey Dossier
en.executive_summary: Official observational records and radio spectrum technosignature audit reports published by the National Astronomical Observatories of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

zh_hk.title: 中國科學院國家天文台：FAST『中國天眼』地外文明搜尋與技術特徵射電巡天官方科研卷宗
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據國家重大科技基礎設施科學規劃，中國科學院國家天文台利用 500 米口徑球面射電望遠鏡 (FAST) 專用後端開展地外智慧信號巡查。卷宗涵蓋多波束窄帶異常電磁信號排查記錄、同儕審查學術公報及跨國射電聯測技術數據。

en.title: Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025
en.executive_summary: House-passed defense authorization bill expanding AARO oversight, mandating ongoing public reporting timelines, and tightening inter-agency anomaly intelligence data sharing.

zh_hk.title: 現役軍人生活質素改善暨 2025 財政年度國防授權法案（眾議院通過版本）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國眾議院審議通過之國防預算法案，進一步擴大國會對 AARO 的法定監督職責，強制收緊跨情報機關與國防設施異常空情數據的共享通報時限，並加強公眾定期報告之問責性。

agencies: Office of the Secretary of Defense (Oversight Context)

en.title: Col. Karl Nell & Sol Foundation: National Strategic Campaign Plan for Controlled UAP Disclosure
en.executive_summary: National strategic campaign blueprint authored by retired Col. Karl Nell outlining timelines, treaty frameworks, and governance protocols for non-human intelligence disclosure.

zh_hk.title: Karl Nell 上校與 Sol 基金會：受控國家披露與非人類智慧 (NHI) 接觸戰略計畫案卷
zh_hk.executive_summary: 曾任北方司令部與陸軍期貨司令部特戰計畫主管之 Karl Nell 上校於 Sol Foundation 發表之防務戰略白皮書。公開確認非人類智慧存在之情報實證，並提出至 2030 年間白宮、國防部與盟國進行分階段披露、條約規範與科學整合之官方政策路徑。

en.title: Department of Homeland Security & DoD: Official Declassified Dossier on Prospective SAP 'KONA BLUE'
en.executive_summary: Declassified Department of Homeland Security records documenting the formal establishment of prospective special access program KONA BLUE for advanced aerospace and anomaly recovery.

zh_hk.title: 美國國土安全部與國防部：『KONA BLUE』預期特殊權限計畫官方解密歷史全卷
zh_hk.executive_summary: 由國土安全部與國防部 AARO 於 2024 年 4 月聯合解密之機密全卷。公文確認國土安全部曾獲准立項建立特殊隔離計畫 (PSAP)，用以接收、保護與逆向工程先進航空航天飛行器 (AAV) 殘骸及未知生物學樣本，為美國官方首次完整解密之墜毀回收專案檔案。

en.title: National Archives and Records Administration: Statutory UAP Records Collection (NDAA FY24 Mandate)
en.executive_summary: Statutory permanent collection established by federal mandate at the US National Archives preserving government-wide declassified anomaly dossiers.

zh_hk.title: 美國國家檔案局 (NARA)：聯邦法定未知異常現象專屬典藏庫 (持續解密更新專案)
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據 2024 財年國防授權法第 1841-1843 條設立之聯邦常設典藏專案。明令國防部、情報界、能源部等全體聯邦機關限期移交所有涉密歷史檔案、照片、遙測圖譜與軍事日誌，並由國家檔案館向全球公眾持續動態解密公開。

agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security

en.title: DoD AARO: Report on the Historical Record of USG Involvement with Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (Volume 1)
en.executive_summary: Official statutory historical review by the Department of Defense examining U.S. government investigations, alleged legacy programs, and special access projects since 1945.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防部 AARO：美國政府參與未知異常現象歷史記錄官方審查報告 (第一卷)
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據 2023 財年國防授權法要求，五角大廈 AARO 調閱 1945 年以來的全部涉密檔案與訪談後發布之 63 頁法定審計報告。全面公開歷代官方機密調查全貌，並揭露國土安全部曾秘密提案之 Kona Blue 逆向工程計畫。

agencies: Department of Defense Office of Inspector General (DoD OIG)
Office of the Secretary of Defense

en.title: DoD Office of Inspector General: Evaluation of the DoD's Actions Regarding Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (Report No. DODIG-2023-109)
en.executive_summary: Statutory oversight evaluation issued by the Inspector General determining that DoD's lack of a comprehensive approach to UAP poses national security risks.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防部督察長辦公室：國防部處理未知異常現象 (UAP) 行動之官方評估與審計報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 國防部最高獨立監察機關對五角大廈、三軍司令部及反情報機構進行全面審計後發布之官方解密報告。報告明確指出國防部缺乏統籌協調的處置政策，未能有效評估與消除 UAP 對國家安全與飛行安全構成之威脅，並提出 11 項強制整改建議。

en.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024 (Public Law 118-31)
en.executive_summary: Enacted federal defense law containing Subtitle C (Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Disclosure), mandating DoD/AARO centralized records collection, reporting mechanisms, and whistleblower protections.

zh_hk.title: 2024 財政年度國防授權法案（聯邦公法第 118-31 號）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國總統簽署生效之聯邦國防法案，包含丙部（未知異常現象披露）專項條款，明令國防部全領域異常解析辦公室 (AARO) 實施中央檔案集中管理、確立軍民通報機制及吹哨者法定義務保障。

agencies: Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security

en.title: DoD AARO: Official Secure Reporting Mechanism for USG & Contractor Personnel with Direct Knowledge
en.executive_summary: Official Department of Defense statutory secure intake channel for authorized personnel reporting legacy special access programs and materials recovery.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防部 AARO：政府與國防承包商涉密人員官方安全通報機制與專案登記體系
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據聯邦法律授權建立之官方安全渠道，受國會吹哨人保護條款支持，專門接收知悉 1945 年以來美國政府涉密計畫、材料逆向工程及未受國會審計之特殊權限專案 (SAP) 的現退役人員宣誓呈報。

en.title: DoD Holding Media Roundtable on the 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
en.executive_summary: Official Department of Defense media briefing transcript regarding anomaly reporting procedures and inter-agency disclosures.

zh_hk.title: 國防部 2023 年度 UAP 綜合調查報告媒體圓桌通報會
zh_hk.executive_summary: 國防部與 AARO 專責官員就 2023 年度提交國會之未解異常現象調查進展向授權媒體進行官方技術簡報與答問。

agencies: Office of the Secretary of Defense

en.title: Pentagon Press Secretary Holds a Press Briefing on AARO Secure Reporting Launch
en.executive_summary: Official Department of Defense media briefing transcript regarding anomaly reporting procedures and inter-agency disclosures.

zh_hk.title: 五角大廈新聞秘書主持 AARO 官方安全通報系統發布記者會
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部新聞發言人正式召開記者會，宣布設立全領域異常解決辦公室官方入口網站，並啟動首階段政府在職人員通報通道。

en.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024
en.executive_summary: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024 This bill authorizes FY2024 appropriations and sets forth policies for Department of Defense (DOD) programs and activities, military construction, the national security programs of the Department of Energy (DOE), and the Maritime Admini...

zh_hk.title: 第 118 屆美國國會 S 2226 號法案（含 UAP 披露條款）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 法案最新進展：Senate ordered measure printed as passed.。涵蓋國防部異常現象調查撥款與跨部會解密審查程序要求。

agencies: 美國眾議院監督與問責委員會

en.title: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency
en.executive_summary: Official printed transcript of the landmark House Oversight sworn hearing featuring testimony from former intelligence officer David Grusch and former naval aviators.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院監督及問責委員會 UAP 宣誓聽證會正式出版紀錄（含證人 Grusch 證詞）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國政府出版局 (GPO) 正式印行之法定公報。記錄前情報官員與海軍飛行員就未公開國防計畫、飛行安全及異常航天目標遭遇事件進行之宣誓證詞。

en.title: UAP Disclosure Act of 2023 (Schumer-Rounds Amendment SA 797 to S. 2226)
en.executive_summary: Bipartisan amendment led by Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer proposing a 9-member independent Presidential Review Board to declassify legacy defense materials and recover non-human intelligence technologies.

zh_hk.title: 2023 年未知異常現象披露法案（舒默－朗茲 UAPDA 跨黨派修正案 SA 797）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 參議院多數黨領袖舒默聯同參議員朗茲提出之里程碑修正案，擬設立由 9 名獨立專家組成、直屬總統且具備傳召取證權之審查委員會，推動跨部會積存之歷史機密檔案與潛在地外科技物證有序向公眾解密。

en.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records: AARO Records Tracking
en.executive_summary: Notice of a modified system of records to include collection and maintenance of anomalous unidentified sightings reported by service members.

zh_hk.title: 1974 年隱私法案；系統記錄通告 (SORN)：AARO 異常個案追蹤記錄庫修訂
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部正式修訂法定系統記錄庫，將現役軍職人員向 AARO 通報之異常飛行與跨領域不明目標目擊數據，納入聯邦私隱法規保護與長期安全存檔機制。

agencies: National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine

en.title: Main Astronomical Observatory of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine: Technical Observations of UAP
en.executive_summary: Observational and photometric measurement study conducted by researchers at the Main Astronomical Observatory, National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine.

zh_hk.title: 烏克蘭國家科學院主要天文台：近地異常空中現象多基站光學技術監測報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 烏克蘭國家科學院主要天文台學者利用基輔與維納里夫卡雙站同步彩色高速感測器，針對對流層與平流層高速移動未知物體進行之光度學與立體成像技術分析。

agencies: 美國眾議院情報常設特別委員會

en.title: Open Hearing on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
en.executive_summary: First open congressional hearing on unidentified aerial phenomena in more than 50 years, featuring testimony from Under Secretary of Defense Ronald Moultrie and Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott Bray.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院情報特別委員會反恐情報小組 UAP 歷史性公開聽證會官方紀錄
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部次長 Ronald Moultrie 與海軍情報副局長 Scott Bray 出席作證，為美國國會超過半世紀以來首次召開之 UAP 公開聽證會官方出版紀錄。

en.title: Argentine Air Force Aerospace Identification Center: Official Resolution and Annual Case Dossier
en.executive_summary: Official aerospace anomaly identification dossiers and sensor analysis released annually by the Argentine Air Force Aerospace Identification Center.

zh_hk.title: 阿根廷空軍航天識別中心 (CIAA)：領空異常現象官方調查與年度鑑定全卷
zh_hk.executive_summary: 由阿根廷空軍作戰司令部常設之航天識別中心 (CIAA) 發布之官方報告，詳細記錄軍用雷達軌跡、多光譜光學鑑定結論與軍航遭遇事件之官方審查結果。

en.title: International Civil Aviation Organization: Standards on Airborne Incident Reporting and Airprox Involving Unidentified Targets
en.executive_summary: Multilateral international civil aviation safety standards and air traffic management protocols for uncoordinated airborne traffic.

zh_hk.title: 國際民用航空組織 (ICAO)：空中未識別物體接近差錯與飛航安全標準通報規範
zh_hk.executive_summary: 依據《芝加哥公約》附件 13 框架及國際民用航空安全通報規程，明文規範國際民航機組員與空管塔台在遭遇未識別異常飛行目標時之雷達信號標註、航行日誌留存及跨國航空主管機關通報標準。
